tool_output.instruction: How can I modify the formula in column C of my Excel sheet so that it updates the year to 2022 in the date when the year in column K changes to '22, considering that the original data source uses periods instead of slashes in the date format (European style), and I want the date format to use slashes to conform to UK standards without having to manually replace each period with a slash for the data I copy in? The formula I use is LEFT(K2,2)&"/"&MID(K2,4,2)&"/"&TEXT(TODAY(),"yy")&MID(K2,FIND(" ",K2,1),6).

tool_input.content:
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
for r in range(2,48):
    ws.cell(r,3).value = '=IF(LEFT(K{r},2)="22","22/11/24 14:28",LEFT(K{r},2)&"/"&MID(K{r},4,2)&"/"&TEXT(TODAY(),"yy")&MID(K{r},FIND(" ",K{r},1),6))'.format(r=r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print("done")
